gloss: soreness after a massage; post-massage pain

definitions.gloss: soreness after a massage; post-massage pain
definitions.explanation: The muscle pain or stiffness that can occur after receiving a massage, especially if the massage was too deep or intense. A common experience discussed in everyday Japanese life.

examples.japanese: マッサージの{揉|も}み{返|かえ}しがきつい。
{強|つよ}く{揉|も}みすぎると{揉|も}み{返|かえ}しが{来|く}る。
examples.english: If you massage too hard, you'll get soreness afterward.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}の{整体|せいたい}の{揉|も}み{返|かえ}しで、{今日|きょう}は{体|からだ}がだるい。
examples.english: Because of the post-massage soreness from yesterday's chiropractic session, my body feels sluggish today.

notes:
FORMS:
{揉|も}む (to massage, to knead) + {返|かえ}し (return, rebound). Literally the 'comeback' from being massaged.

USAGE:
Very common in everyday conversation when discussing massage experiences. Often used with {来|く}る ({揉|も}み{返|かえ}しが{来|く}る) to express the onset of post-massage soreness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揉|も}み{返|かえ}しが{来|く}る (to get post-massage soreness)
- {揉|も}み{返|かえ}しがひどい (the soreness is bad)
- {揉|も}み{返|かえ}しが{残|のこ}る (soreness lingers)
